title.en: An Act Creating an Extension Office of the MAritime Industry Authority in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Creating an Extension Office of the MAritime Industry Authority in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2022/ra_11760_2022.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: An extension office of the Maritime Industry Authority (MARINA) shall be created in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur. The extension office shall provide services for the residents of the Province of Ilocos Sur and other nearby provinces.

The Administrator of the MARINA shall immediately include in the Agency's programs the operationalization of the MARINA Extension Office in Vigan City, Ilocos Sur, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall become effective fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
